description: Get technical indicators for an asset, computed on-demand from LDBD end-of-day price history: moving-average ladder (5/10/20/50/100/200 — price-vs-MA % and 10-day slope), 52-week high/low distance, RSI(14, Wilder), 20-day annualized realized volatility, 5d/20d volume ratio, and 1w/1m/3m trailing returns. Public, no API key needed. Works for US, KRX, and crypto symbols. Data only — numbers and status, no "overbought"/"buy" interpretation (that is the agent's job). Short history returns the computable subset plus a `missing` list.
name: ldbd_get_chart_indicators
